# Auto-Cleanse

> Auto-Cleanse is a Devon-based specialist in diesel particulate filter (DPF) cleaning, ECU remapping and vehicle diagnostics, based at a workshop in Totnes, South Devon. DPF cleaning is carried out off the vehicle at the workshop (with local collection, drop-off and UK-wide postal options); ECU remapping is available at the workshop or as a mobile service across Devon.

Key facts:

- Workshop: The Old Barn Industrial Estate, Webbers Yard, Totnes, Devon TQ9 6JY. Phone: 07823 649190.
- DPF cleaning is a workshop / off-vehicle service, not a mobile service. Mobile visits are for ECU remapping only.
- Diagnostics are a paid service, not free.
- Services genuinely offered: DPF cleaning (collection, drop-off, UK postal), blocked-DPF and DPF diagnostics, ECU remapping (Stage 1 and Stage 2), mobile ECU remapping, economy/van/4x4/fleet remapping, ECU cloning, AdBlue/SCR repair and diagnostics, and a trade ECU/TCU file service for garages and mobile tuners.

## DPF cleaning & diagnostics

- [DPF cleaning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning): off-vehicle DPF cleaning with collection, workshop drop-off and postal options.
- [DPF cleaning near me](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning-near-me): how to reach us - drop-off, Devon collection, or UK postal.
- [DPF collection across Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-cleaning-devon): Devon-wide DPF collection and trade cleaning.
- [Postal DPF cleaning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/postal-dpf): UK-wide send-in DPF cleaning.
- [Blocked DPF help](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/blocked-dpf-cleaning-devon): warning-light and limp-mode diagnosis and cleaning.
- [DPF diagnostics](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/dpf-diagnostics-devon): paid diagnosis to find the cause before cleaning or replacement.

## ECU remapping & tuning

- [ECU remapping](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/ecu-remapping): Stage 1 and Stage 2 tuning for cars, vans and 4x4s.
- [Vehicle remap lookup (make & model)](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/vehicle-performance-lookup): hub to check Stage 1 power and torque gains by vehicle make and model.
- [Mobile ECU remapping in Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/mobile-ecu-remapping-devon): remapping at your home or workplace across Devon.
- [Stage 1 remaps in Devon](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/stage-1-remaps-devon): the most popular software-only upgrade.
- [ECU cloning](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/ecu-cloning): cloning a faulty or damaged ECU onto a replacement unit.

## AdBlue

- [AdBlue & SCR repair and diagnostics](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair-devon): diagnosing and repairing AdBlue/SCR faults in Devon (our own technicians).
- [AdBlue repair](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair): repair-only AdBlue service. Our own technicians in Devon; elsewhere an independent mobile technician from our national network, booked and managed by us. Prices are given on the phone after checking the vehicle and fault.
- [AdBlue repair areas](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair/areas): town-by-town pages with local roads, nearby service areas and stations listed as selling AdBlue at the pump.
- [AdBlue no-start countdown](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-countdown-no-start): what "starting impossible in X miles" means and what to do.
- [AdBlue warning light](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-warning-light): low level, quality and fault warnings explained.
- [Fault code P20EE](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-fault-codes/p20ee): SCR efficiency below threshold, and why to diagnose before replacing the catalyst.
- [Fault code P20E8](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-fault-codes/p20e8): AdBlue (reductant) pressure too low.
- [Fault code P204F](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-fault-codes/p204f): AdBlue (reductant) system performance.
- [NOx sensor faults](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair/nox-sensor): upstream and downstream NOx sensors, codes and proper replacement.
- [Peugeot, Citroen and Vauxhall AdBlue tank faults](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-repair/peugeot-citroen-vauxhall-adblue-tank): BlueHDi AdBlue tank symptoms, manufacturer cover and repair.
- [AdBlue delete and the law](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/adblue-delete-law): why disabling AdBlue is not legal on the road, and the legal fix.
- [How we quote](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/how-we-quote): why prices are given on the phone, and what happens after you call.

## Trade

- [Trade ECU & TCU file service](https://www.auto-cleanse.co.uk/trade-file-service): a file service for garages and mobile tuners (Stage 1/2, TCU, economy and custom requests; no DPF, EGR or AdBlue delete files).
